name: Mycosynth Fiend
oracle_text: This creature gets +1/+1 for each poison counter your opponents have.
blocked_sentences: This creature gets +1/+1 for each poison counter your opponents have.

needs.what: a static value leaf (e.g. {"poison_of": "each_opponent"}) that SUMS PlayerState.poison over a player spec, usable as a buff's power/toughness magnitude, so the creature gets +1/+1 per poison counter across all opponents combined
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The only poison leaf in static_value_keys is max_poison_of, which takes the most poison on ONE opponent (the corrupted threshold reading); at a multiplayer table with opponents at 2 and 3 poison it gives +3/+3 instead of the printed +5/+5. counters_on cannot reach player counters, and sum cannot iterate per-opponent because no single-opponent player spec exists
